summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload at npm install
details: The package declares a preinstall hook ("node setup.mjs") that downloads a Bun runtime release from github.com/oven-sh/bun to a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the shipped file math_init.js (execFileSync of the downloaded Bun binary with math_init.js as its argument). math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (WV8StW string-array rotation dispatcher over a mixed hex/string constant array, hex identifier names) that is not referenced by the declared main entry (dist/index.js is a 5-line re-export). The package presents itself as a shared communication registry module, a purpose that has no need for a Bun runtime or a large obfuscated companion script. The alternate-runtime dispatch pattern executes the payload under a freshly-downloaded runtime distinct from the Node interpreter that runs the rest of npm's lifecycle, so the obfuscated code runs on every installer's machine at npm install time with its behavior opaque to source review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
